question_text:
The kinetics of the austenite-to-pearlite transformation obeys the Avrami relationship. Using the fraction transformed-time data given here, determine the total time required for $95 \%$ of the austenite to transform to pearlite:

| Fraction Transformed | Time $(\mathrm{s})$ |
| :--: | :--: |
| 0.2 | 280 |
| 0.6 | 425 |The unit of the answer is s.
response:
The Avrami equation is $y = 1 - \exp(-k t^n)$. Taking $\ln(1-y) = -k t^n$ and dividing the two data points eliminates $k$:

$$\frac{\ln 0.8}{\ln 0.4} = \left(\frac{280}{425}\right)^n \;\Rightarrow\; n \approx 3.385$$

Then $k = -\ln(0.8)/280^n \approx 1.16\times10^{-9}$. For $y=0.95$:

$$t = \left(\frac{-\ln 0.05}{k}\right)^{1/n} \approx 603.1\ \text{s}$$

$$\boxed{603.1}$$
